subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should this feature intentionally retire released query-form session URLs, including previously published ClickClack links, or preserve them through a route-boundary migration before path URLs become canonical?
rationale: The patch explicitly chooses a breaking public URL contract, while repository policy treats compatibility-sensitive public behavior and generated links as requiring an explicit maintainer choice rather than an implementation-only assumption.

options.title: Translate released links
options.body: Preserve `?session=` and `?face=` at the route boundary, replace the URL with the canonical path, and retain the new path grammar as the single steady-state form.

options.title: Accept the bookmark break
options.body: Document and release-note the intentional incompatibility, including the impact on ClickClack links and native restore state, before merging.

recommendation.title: Translate released links
recommendation.body: Preserve `?session=` and `?face=` at the route boundary, replace the URL with the canonical path, and retain the new path grammar as the single steady-state form.
